I replied in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on November 3, 2025.

- **Sources:** Moss's Coastal digest of Nov 2 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Your own Dec 8 cutover recap gives the same date.
- **Caveat for the tracker:** Your recap says you kept running the account day to day until Nov 21. Kwame took over fully on Nov 22, 2025.

I told you to use Nov 3 for the official change, and Nov 22 if the tracker records when Kwame actually took over.
